description: This file defines the 'MyAttendanceRecordAPI' class which extends 'EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI' and manages employee attendance record-related API endpoints, including date-time extraction, validation, and user action permissions within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: MyAttendanceRecordAPI
classes.description: API class managing employee attendance records, including validation, time extraction, and permission checks.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for 'get all records' endpoint, removing employee number parameter from parent rules.

methods.name: extractPunchDateTime
methods.description: Creates a DateTime object from a string and timezone offset, validating if user can change time settings.

methods.name: isCurrantDateTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided date-time is within a +/- 180 seconds window of the current time in the user's timezone.

methods.name: userAllowedPunchInActions
methods.description: Determines if the user is permitted to perform punch-in actions based on allowed actions.

methods.name: userAllowedPunchOutActions
methods.description: Determines if the user is permitted to perform punch-out actions based on allowed actions.
